note: A feasibility-graded INDEX over the committed Reel packs (docs/reel-packs), not a parallel list: 88 of the 100 angles name the pack that already carries their brief; 12 are gaps with no pack. A named pack must be one the PRODUCTION builder accepts (buildBriefFromApprovedProductionPack — the daily lane's own instrument; 137 of 201 packs on 2026-10-08), not merely one with beats on disk. Rank order IS the production order. The first 20 are production-ready (buildable brief, route decided, real evidence named); A001-A008 are the 8-Reel pilot (08-PILOT.md). shared/angleBank.ts validates this file and shared/angleBank.test.ts checks every packSlug against the builder, the category spacing, near-duplicates and which production-ready packs are in the daily rotation. Feasibility: A = real stills obtainable on any week's jobs + a deterministic card; B = needs a specific job (alignment rack, balancer, scan tool, a scrap part); C = needs a rig, a cut-open part or a labelled illustrative shot; D = a truth packet or source must exist first. Route = the shot router's cheapest accepted method for the evidence beats.
